summary: No new defects found by static review. Both prior Codex findings are addressed, and the python -P rebuttal matches the implementation. Required checks were not run because the read-only sandbox and review instructions prohibit execution.

checks.criterion: AC1: Document class, repository style, packages, fonts, title, author and empty date.
checks.evidence: paper/main.tex:1-12 matches the required class and metadata; paper/arxiv.sty:3-20 sets geometry and loads the required packages without fontenc or inputenc.

checks.criterion: AC2: Empty abstract, exact section skeleton and include order, with only two appendices.
checks.evidence: paper/main.tex:4-35 has the required preamble and include order. All twelve section files contain only the required section and label lines. wc reports paper/abstract.tex is 0 bytes; the tracked paper files contain no Appendix C.

checks.criterion: AC3: Deterministic number generator, empty MACROS, header-only committed artifact and no premature figure artifacts.
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/numbers.py:29-55 defines the exact header and empty MACROS; :143-159 preserves spec order; :163-198 writes UTF-8 bytes with explicit LF and a trailing newline. Byte inspection confirms paper/generated/numbers.tex contains exactly the two required comments. No figures target, figures.py or measurement-review.json is present.

checks.criterion: AC4: Production bundle validation, provenance, invalid-value rejection and unchanged output on errors.
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/numbers.py:62-159 implements name, pointer, numeric-value and manifest checks, including validate_bundle(bundle, production=True); :193-198 returns before writing on reported errors. paper/Makefile:18 passes the selected release directory. Runtime failure and preservation behavior could not be exercised under the read-only review restriction.

checks.criterion: AC5: Number tests written and run failing first, with all required temporary-bundle cases.
checks.evidence: Git trees show test_numbers.py exists at a8e74f1 before numbers.py is added at 9e0ba17. paper/scripts/test_numbers.py:62-77 uses write_bundle with the required fields; :119-453 contains the required cases. Historical failing execution and current test results were not independently verified; checks are prohibited in this read-only review.

checks.criterion: AC6: Manuscript tests written first, with positive and negative examples for every required rule.
checks.evidence: The 70db065 tree contains manuscript tests before the skeleton. paper/scripts/test_manuscript.py:127-666 implements the six rules and their examples. The prior graphics fix at :443-478 recognizes starred forms and rejects unreadable commands; :515-565 supplies regression cases. Test execution is prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: AC7: Post-Tectonic log gate and tests for every required failure pattern.
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/check_log.py:24-47 defines the log and BibTeX rules; :65-105 applies them and fails on findings. paper/scripts/test_check_log.py:44-190 covers clean logs, required patterns and the 1pt boundary. paper/Makefile:55-56 invokes the gate after Tectonic. Runtime verification is prohibited in this read-only review.

checks.criterion: AC8: GNU Make 3.81/POSIX build, pinned bundle, ordered targets, drift check and existing Python toolchain.
checks.evidence: paper/Makefile:3-56 contains the required variables, serialization, target order, temporary-file diff, tool commands and missing-Tectonic message. The listed story commits change neither pyproject.toml nor uv.lock. Compatibility and build execution cannot be verified in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: AC9: Ignored build output, short README, successful documented commands and proposed root instruction.
checks.evidence: .gitignore:41-49 covers Tectonic outputs, and git ls-files paper contains none. paper/README.md:7-22 lists the required prerequisites, bundle and commands. The proposed root README line exists at scripts/ralph/batches/t16-paper/progress.txt:913. The listed story commits leave root README, Makefile and .gitignore unchanged. Documented command success was not independently verified because execution is prohibited.
